tools.name: rate_lookup

origin.description: The city name for the non-airport end of the trip - used only as the pricing zone-lookup key. This does not represent or imply the direction of travel (for an airport arrival, the airport is the true start of the trip even though this field holds the drop-off city) - use trip_origin and trip_destination for anything that needs to state or reason about direction.

passengers.description: Number of passengers - the already-settled count, sent automatically. Never a value you invent or re-derive.

leg_2_summary.description: Summary of a second trip leg, if any.

vehicle_key.description: The vehicle class key selected by the capacity matrix.

trip_destination.description: The true end point of this trip in plain English, correctly ordered by direction - the passenger's drop-off address for an airport arrival, the airport for an airport departure, or the drop-off address/duration for a charter/point-to-point trip. Pairs with trip_origin.

hours.description: Requested charter hours, if hourly. The engine may enforce a higher minimum - see billable_hours in the response.

trip_origin.description: The true starting point of this trip in plain English, correctly ordered by direction - the airport for an airport arrival (the caller lands there first), or the pickup address for an airport departure or a charter/point-to-point trip. Use this (with trip_destination) to build any customer-facing wording of the route, such as the quote confirmation message - never derive direction from `origin`.

trip_type.description: Exactly 'airport' for any airport arrival or departure trip, or 'hourly' for a charter/hourly trip.

qty.description: Quantity of this add-on, defaults to 1 if omitted

seat_type.description: Required when key is child_seat: infant, convertible, or booster

addons.description: Requested add-ons that affect pricing. Include one entry with key 'meet_greet' whenever pickup_style is meet-and-greet. Include one separate entry with key 'child_seat' for each individual child seat needed - set that entry's seat_type (infant, convertible, or booster) and qty, based on child_seat_count and child_seat_types (usually qty 1 per entry, or the count of seats sharing that exact type). Omit entirely if there are no add-ons.

airport.description: The airport code, when the trip involves an airport.

leg_1_summary.description: Summary of the primary trip leg.

pickup_at.description: Pickup date/time - determines weekday vs weekend pricing.

stops_count.description: Number of stops on the trip beyond the single pickup and single drop-off, if any

tools.description: Looks up the applicable rate for the trip. Returns a status of exactly one of: QUOTED, CAPTURE_ONLY, CORPORATE_RATE_REQUIRED, NO_ROUTE_FOUND, INPUT_INCOMPLETE, HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED, RATE_ENGINE_FAILED, or UNAUTHORIZED. When QUOTED, `message` is the only spoken price source — it already contains the vehicle, route, one whole-dollar total, and the service fee note; never construct a price sentence from other fields. Also returns capacity_ok (present as false only when the assumed vehicle doesn't fit), suggested_vehicle (present when a better vehicle fits), quote_source, quote_id, superseded_quote_id (set when this quote replaces an earlier one), route_miles, vehicle, all_in_total, and billable_hours (the engine-enforced hours for hourly trips, which may differ from what the caller requested). Pricing-affecting add-ons (meet-and-greet, child seats) are sent via addons and priced into the total by the engine.

nodes.name: N05 Capacity Matrix

instruction.text: One moment while I check the rate.

Say exactly the contents of {{message}}, word for word - do not add, remove, paraphrase, or reorder anything in it. If {{account_type}} is not 'corporate', add exactly one more sentence immediately after: "I don't show a card on file for you — I'll text you a secure booking link." Say nothing else.
That'll be our {{vehicle_class_label}} — booking to the contract rate.
No approved rate for that route. I'll capture the trip for dispatch review.
This needs dispatch review — they'll call you back with the number.
Can't verify the rate right now. I'll capture the details and have dispatch call you.

Briefly acknowledge whatever the caller just gave you, referencing it specifically, then in the same breath check which of passenger count, pickup date/time, pickup location, or drop-off/duration is still missing or unclear, and ask for exactly that one item - nothing else. Do not re-ask anything already provided, and do not mention any technical failure - this is a normal follow-up question.

transition_condition.prompt: Caller has provided the missing detail

tools.description: Save whichever missing trip detail the caller just provided so the rate engine can be retried.

variables.description: Drop-off location, or duration in hours for an hourly charter
variables.name: dropoff_or_duration

tools.name: save_missing_rate_detail

nodes.name: N06 Missing Slot - Repeat Guard

instruction.text: I've got what you've given me. I'll have dispatch pull this together and confirm the rate with you.
Can't quote a firm number for this one - I'll capture it and have dispatch price it by hand.

transition_condition.prompt: The caller named any specific vehicle class in their reply - whether agreeing to the recommendation, naming a third alternative, or asking to keep a different class than what was assumed

tools.description: Save the vehicle class the caller agreed to move to.
tools.name: confirm_vehicle_recommendation

variables.description: Set to whichever specific vehicle class the caller named: the engine's suggested_vehicle value if they agree with the recommendation, or their explicitly requested class (sedan, suv, van_sprinter, or stretch) if they name anything else - including the originally-assumed class if they ask to keep that one by name.
variables.name: vehicle_class

variables.description: Always set to true when this tool is called - marks that the caller has explicitly settled on a vehicle class, so this node is never re-entered for the rest of the call.
variables.name: vehicle_manually_confirmed

instruction.text:
Tell the caller you'd recommend the {{suggested_vehicle}} for this trip instead of what was assumed - if {{capacity_ok}} is false, briefly note their party or luggage doesn't fit the vehicle currently assumed; otherwise just note it's the better fit. Ask if that works for them.

If the caller names ANY specific vehicle class at all in their reply - whether that's agreeing to the recommendation, naming a third alternative, or asking to keep a class different from what was currently assumed - call confirm_vehicle_recommendation exactly once this turn with that named vehicle, then immediately transition. Do not call the tool more than once for the same decision, and do not wait for further confirmation before transitioning. Never speak a next-topic line (contact info, readback, or anything else) before that transition happens - the tool call and the transition happen together, in the same turn, with nothing else in between.

Only skip the tool and just move on (no requote) if the caller declines to change anything without naming any specific vehicle class - e.g. 'just keep going' or 'whatever you had already' with no class mentioned.
